say:9:1320632008:1.text: If we could transfer these remaining fragments to the golem, he may be able to hold on longer...

say:10:1320632009:1.text: Would my brother still be in pain?
say:10:1320632009:1.source_cn: 那样的哥哥，还会感到痛苦吗？

say:11:1320632010:1.text: The agony of a sundered soul will never truly fade. Yet, I believe he will find some relief.
say:11:1320632010:1.source_cn: 灵魂被撕裂的痛苦永远无法消退。但我想，他会好过一些。

say:12:1320632011:1.text: In that case, I must decline. I can't bear to see my brother endure any more pain.
say:12:1320632011:1.source_cn: 那么，请允许我拒绝。我不要哥哥再承受任何痛苦了。

say:14:1320632013:1.text: Callan! Is he trying to say something? I can't hear him clearly...
say:14:1320632013:1.source_cn: ……哥哥！他是想说什么吗？但是我什么也听不清……

say:16:1320632014:1.text: That's mechanical language. He says he still wants to stay by your side.
say:16:1320632014:1.source_cn: 那是机械的语言，他还是想留在你身边。

say:18:1320632015:1.text: I think this all depends on Callan's own wishes.
say:18:1320632015:1.source_cn: ……我想，这要取决于铐兰自己的意愿。

say:19:1320632016:1.text: Callan, do you still want to continue despite everything? Father and mother are gone, and even Rigel has passed on.
say:19:1320632016:1.source_cn: 哥哥，即便这样，你也想要坚持下去吗……？父亲和母亲大人...

narration:20:1320632017:1.text: Carolina leans her head against the motionless golem, listening quietly as Hugin tries to convey what Callan is saying.

narration:21:1320632018:1.text: After a long time, Carolina rises with tears frozen on her face.

say:22:1320632019:1.text: My lord, my brother has decided... He wishes to stay in this body.
say:22:1320632019:1.source_cn: 子爵先生，哥哥他……决定了。他不想离开。

say:24:1320632021:1.text: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.
say:24:1320632021:1.male: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.
say:24:1320632021:1.female: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.

say:25:1320632022:1.text: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.
say:25:1320632022:1.source_cn: 这次是逆向操作，我会把铐兰遗骸中的灵魂碎片放入现在的机...
say:25:1320632022:1.male: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.
say:25:1320632022:1.female: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.

say:26:1320632023:1.text: I hope that this can give him some peace...
say:26:1320632023:1.source_cn: 希望或多或少，能让他获得些许安宁……

choice:6:0:1.text: Can we somehow repair his soul?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 如果想办法修复他的灵魂呢？
choice:6:0:1.male: Can we somehow repair his soul?
choice:6:0:1.female: Can we somehow repair his soul?

choice:6:1:2.text: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你是柳博米尔·瓦勒沙，想想办法！
choice:6:1:2.male: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!
choice:6:1:2.female: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!

narration:1:1320611001:0.text: After a careful and meticulous inspection...
narration:1:1320611001:0.source_cn: 一番轻柔细致的检查调试后……

say:3:1320611002:0.text: The casting on him is quite remarkable. His parts were all riveted together seamlessly. It's rare to see such fine work!
say:3:1320611002:0.source_cn: 相当出色的铸造工艺，零件浇筑和铆合得天衣无缝。真是难得...

say:4:1320611003:1.text: Who created this work of art? I can see that the creator incorporated some of our dwarven concepts. One of my fellow dwarves must've participated in this creation as well.
say:4:1320611003:1.source_cn: 这是谁打造的作品？能看出设计者有融合我们矮人技艺的痕迹...

say:5:1320611004:1.text: I think the golem was designed by my brother and his companions. My brother loved reading about new inventions and had many dwarven friends.
say:5:1320611004:1.source_cn: 我想，是哥哥和他的朋友一起设计的，哥哥生前喜欢读书与发...

say:6:1320611005:1.text: My brother often spoke of the crucial role machines could play in the war against the Hypofiends, leading him to research and create golems with his friends...
say:6:1320611005:1.source_cn: 哥哥说，机械能在对抗魔物的战争中发挥重要功能，所以一直...

say:7:1320611006:1.text: No wonder this was so well made!

say:8:1320611007:1.text: However, this big lad is too quiet. I could hear all sorts of mechanical sounds inside, but not a peep out of him.
say:8:1320611007:1.source_cn: 不过，这位壮硕的小伙子格外安静，我能听到机械造物发出各...

choice_prompt:9:1320611007.text: However, this big lad is too quiet. I could hear all sorts of mechanical sounds inside, but not a peep out of him.
choice_prompt:9:1320611007.source_cn: 不过，这位壮硕的小伙子格外安静，我能听到机械造物发出各种各样的声音，但他不一样，他只是一声不吭。

say:10:1320611008:1.text: From what I can see, there shouldn't be a problem. The gears are running well. Everything is well-lubricated. The person maintaining this golem is doing a great job.
say:10:1320611008:1.source_cn: 从我的经验来看，他没有问题。齿轮运转良好，润滑足够到位...

say:11:1320611009:1.text: Although the power reactor is empty, he doesn't seem to be powered by any sort of energy I know of.
say:11:1320611009:1.source_cn: 虽然动力炉是空的，不过他看起来并不是靠能源驱动——

say:12:1320611010:1.text: Wait, his power reactor is empty?
say:12:1320611010:1.source_cn: 等等，他的动力炉是空的？

say:13:1320611011:1.text: Yeah, I opened it, and there was nothing inside. Judging from the capacity, even if it was full, it could only stay operational for a week or two.
say:13:1320611011:1.source_cn: 当然，我打开看过，一点能源都没留下。从容量判断，就算满...

say:14:1320611012:1.text: Judging from the funny looks on your faces, I can tell that you all know nothing about the structure of this big lad, let alone how to add energy to his reactor.
say:14:1320611012:1.source_cn: 看你们这一脸面面相觑的模样，就知道你们对这小伙子的结构...

say:15:1320611013:1.text: I can hazard a guess that this golem was powered by magic, which is not my area of expertise.
say:15:1320611013:1.source_cn: 所以我敢断定，他之前能运转完全是靠魔法驱动。那就不是我...

say:16:1320611014:1.text: Can my brother ever wake up?

say:17:1320611015:1.text: From a mechanical standpoint, I can't give you a definite answer.
say:17:1320611015:1.source_cn: 从机械工艺的角度，我给不了任何建议，孩子。

say:18:1320611016:1.text: How could this happen? Callan... We've spent so much time together. Are you going to abandon me now?
say:18:1320611016:1.source_cn: 怎么会这样……？哥哥……我们一起度过了那么久的时光，你...

say:19:1320611017:1.source_cn: 哎哎，这娃儿，怎么哭起来了！

say:21:1320611018:1.text: Thank you for your suggestion, Master Hugin. Since it's related to magic, it's better to leave it to us.
say:21:1320611018:1.source_cn: 感谢你的建议，呼金工匠，既然与魔法有关，后续交给我们为好。

say:22:1320611019:1.text: Then you all better comfort the child. I can't bear to see a little girl cry.
say:22:1320611019:1.source_cn: 那你们哄着点那娃儿，我看不得小姑娘哭。

say:24:1320611020:0.text: I'll continue studying the big lad on the ground... Hmm?
say:24:1320611020:0.source_cn: 我还是接着研究地上倒着的小伙子吧……嗯？

say:28:1320611022:1.text: Since Callan is powered by magic, maybe Ludovic and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can find a way to help.
say:28:1320611022:1.source_cn: 既然铐兰是由魔法驱动，那<style=stress><...
say:28:1320611022:1.male: Since Callan is powered by magic, maybe Ludovic and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can find a way to help.
say:28:1320611022:1.female: Since Callan is powered by magic, maybe Ludovic and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can find a way to help.

choice_prompt:29:1320611022.male: Since Callan is powered by magic, maybe Ludovic and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can find a way to help.
choice_prompt:29:1320611022.female: Since Callan is powered by magic, maybe Ludovic and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can find a way to help.

say:30:1320611023:0.text: I have knowledge of a sinister Graveborn magic that chains a soul to a mortal body. The anguish it causes varies, often leading to unbearable torment for the bound soul.
say:30:1320611023:0.source_cn: 我知道有一种将灵魂强制束缚在躯体上的亡灵魔法，根据躯体...

say:31:1320611024:1.text: I will try testing the soul in the body.
say:31:1320611024:1.source_cn: 我会尝试试探那具躯体中的灵魂。

say:35:1320611028:1.text: I'm hoping that Radinov's descendant isn't suffering that kind of torture...
say:35:1320611028:1.source_cn: 希望拉季诺夫的后人……不要遭受那种折磨。

narration:41:13020625:0.text: Ludovic uses magic to examine Callan's mechanical body once again.
narration:41:13020625:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔用亡灵魔法又一次检查了铐兰的机械躯体。

choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 看起来是亡灵法术，不想碰啊……

choice:29:2:3.text: I want a golem in the future.
choice:29:2:3.source_cn: 魔法机械真酷，我也想搞一个
choice:29:2:3.male: I want a golem in the future.
choice:29:2:3.female: I want a golem in the future.

say:1:1320627001:0.text: There still seems to be no response. These handwritten letters alone are not enough.
say:1:1320627001:0.source_cn: ……还是没有反应。光凭这些手写书信仍然不够。

say:2:1320627002:1.text: What precious item would awaken his Callan's soul then...?
say:2:1320627002:1.source_cn: 对于哥哥来说，能唤起他灵魂的珍贵东西到底是什么呢？

say:3:1320627003:1.text: Miss Carolina, did Callan leave behind any other important belongings before his death?
say:3:1320627003:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜小姐，铐兰生前没有再留下其他重要的东西了吗？

say:4:1320627004:1.text: Nothing... He stayed with me after he was turned into a golem. We wandered around the snowy remains of our estate, but all that was left were broken walls and empty rooms.
say:4:1320627004:1.source_cn: 没有了，他变成机械人偶后一直陪着我，我们在下雪的庄园遗...

say:5:1320627005:1.text: His past, my childhood, and everything we've been through... It's all gone.
say:5:1320627005:1.source_cn: 他的过去，我的童年，我们共同经历过的一切……都已经不复存在。

choice_prompt:6:1320627005.text: His past, my childhood, and everything we've been through... It's all gone.
choice_prompt:6:1320627005.source_cn: 他的过去，我的童年，我们共同经历过的一切……都已经不复存在。

say:7:1320627006:1.text: You wish for Carolina to act as a medium to bring her brother's soul back? She's not an object; she's a living being with her own soul!
say:7:1320627006:1.source_cn: 你想让卡列琳娜亲自当牵引铐兰灵魂的媒介？她不是一件物品...
say:7:1320627006:1.male: You wish for Carolina to act as a medium to bring her brother's soul back? She's not an object; she's a living being with her own soul!
say:7:1320627006:1.female: You wish for Carolina to act as a medium to bring her brother's soul back? She's not an object; she's a living being with her own soul!

say:8:1320627007:1.text: The magic for extracting and transferring souls is incredibly dangerous. If done incorrectly, it could cause irreversible harm to both Carolina and Callan.
say:8:1320627007:1.source_cn: 牵引灵魂的魔法极其危险，操作不当会对铐兰和卡列琳娜的灵...
say:8:1320627007:1.male: The magic for extracting and transferring souls is incredibly dangerous. If done incorrectly, it could cause irreversible harm to both Carolina and Callan.
say:8:1320627007:1.female: The magic for extracting and transferring souls is incredibly dangerous. If done incorrectly, it could cause irreversible harm to both Carolina and Callan.

say:10:1320627009:1.text: I haven't tested it on anyone, and I don't plan to.
say:10:1320627009:1.source_cn: 我没有试过，而且不想在任何人身上尝试。

say:11:1320627010:1.text: My lord, please hear what I have to say. I honestly don't mind.
say:11:1320627010:1.source_cn: ……子爵先生，请听我说。我不介意。

say:12:1320627011:1.text: In fact, I very much like to try.

say:13:1320627012:1.text: Your soul could be torn asunder, and you might endure unbearable pain just like Callan. This agony will embed itself in your soul, lasting beyond any eternity you can conceive.
say:13:1320627012:1.source_cn: 你的灵魂可能被撕裂，和铐兰一样承受难以忍受的痛苦，那种...

say:14:1320627013:1.text: It's what my brother has been enduring, is it not?
say:14:1320627013:1.source_cn: 这就是哥哥一直在承受的，对么？

say:15:1320627014:1.text: Yes, but Callan has already suffered. You're different.
say:15:1320627014:1.source_cn: 铐兰已经承受过痛苦了，你和他不一样。

say:16:1320627015:1.text: Your willingness to sacrifice yourself shows you're truly a Radinov... Why must fate torment Eamon's descendants this way?
say:16:1320627015:1.source_cn: 你是拉季诺夫家的人……命运为什么一定要这样作弄叶夫尼的...

say:17:1320627016:1.text: I appreciate your concern, my lord, but how can I run away when I can now share his pain after making my brother suffer for so long due to my own selfish desires?
say:17:1320627016:1.source_cn: 感谢您的关怀，子爵先生。但是我已经为了自己自私的愿望而...

say:18:1320627017:1.text: Moreover, your cautious nature reassures me that you will strive to fulfill my and my brother's wishes.
say:18:1320627017:1.source_cn: 而且，您那么谨慎温柔，我相信您会拼尽全力实现我和哥哥的愿望。

say:19:1320627018:1.text: Let us have him rest in peace.

say:22:1320627020:1.text: It's maddening that the Radinovs always choose to sacrifice themselves...
say:22:1320627020:1.source_cn: ……我讨厌拉季诺夫家的人总是选择自我牺牲。

say:23:1320627021:1.text: If you're prepared, Carolina, step in front of Callan, and please don't let me regret this.
say:23:1320627021:1.source_cn: 如果你做好了准备……卡列琳娜，站到铐兰面前吧，不要给我...

cinematic_dialogue:28:1320628006:.source_cn: 他在抗拒灵魂转移的魔法！

narration:30:13020646:0.text: Carolina volunteers to be the guidepost for transferring souls. Callan finally reacts, but it is to resist Ludovic's magic.
narration:30:13020646:0.source_cn: 这一次，卡列琳娜自愿充当转移灵魂的媒介，铐兰终于出现了...

choice:21:0:1.text: Still can't make up your mind?
choice:21:0:1.male: Still can't make up your mind?
choice:21:0:1.female: Still can't make up your mind?

choice:6:0:1.male: You and your memory of him are still here.

choice:6:1:2.male: Can another soul serve as a medium?
choice:6:1:2.female: Can another soul serve as a medium?

say:1:1320633001:0.text: Should I continue calling to my brother?
say:1:1320633001:0.source_cn: 我还要继续呼唤哥哥吗？

say:2:1320633002:0.text: Yes, as his most cherished relative, your voice must reach his soul.
say:2:1320633002:0.source_cn: 是的，作为他最珍重的血亲，你的声音必须要传达给他的灵魂。

say:3:1320633003:1.text: I understand. If that's the case, there is something I want to try.
say:3:1320633003:1.source_cn: 我明白了……如果是这样的话，我有想做的事情。

say:7:1320633006:1.female: It won't be him telling me a tale but me sharing our story with him.

say:11:1320633009:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜拿起故事书，清了清嗓子。

say:14:1320633011:1.source_cn: “有一位伟大的魔法师，他掌握世界上一切魔法，风趣又洒脱...

say:15:1320633012:1.source_cn: “……那么，就让我来保护你吧，大魔法师说。我会用魔法替...
